en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural road leading toward a church tower partly hidden by large trees. A small horse‑drawn cart travels along the dirt road while a person walks on the left side near fields. On the right is a farmhouse or outbuilding with a tiled roof and wooden fences. Printed captions at the top identify the place and the Lutheran church in multiple languages (Cyrillic and German).
